title: My Son Forged My Signature On A Buyout And Kicked Me Off Our Mushroom Farm. So I Proved It In Court.
description: I trusted my son with my entire $110,000 divorce settlement, buying into his organic mushroom farm as his partner. When he forged a buyout amendment to steal my share, I proved it in court with a forensics expert and won full ownership. Now he works for me in a shirt that says 'My Spores Are Real.' #FamilyBetrayal #Forgery #ProRevenge
thumb_text: I PROVED MY SON FORGED MY SIGNATURE AND WON HIS FARM
pinned_comment: If your own child forged your signature to steal your life savings and left you with a $10,000 check, would you have taken them to court or just walked away? I'd love to hear your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I HIRED A FORENSIC EXAMINER TO PROVE THE FORGERY
